description: Public access block is disabled on a production bucket.
remediation: Enable S3 public access block and remove public bucket access.
statusExtended: Bucket level public access block is disabled.

description: A security group allows inbound SSH from 0.0.0.0/0.
remediation: Restrict the security group to approved source ranges and remove internet-wide SSH access.
statusExtended: Ingress rule exposes TCP/22 to the internet.
